title: Valuation fail-open critical — NAV/HF/emergency proceed with silent partial/failed data
impact: Deposit, withdraw e rebalance normali NON revertano su NAV parziale o failed price data: shares vengono mintate/bruciate contro un TVL sistematicamente sottostimato, con conseguente dilution/gift asimmetrico tra LP e attaccanti. L'emergency response condivide lo stesso NAV, quindi non riesce a distinguere lo stato reale del pool: gli auto-close guidati da HF possono chiudere posizioni sane (Ref: NEW-007) o non chiudere posizioni malate (Ref: PLG-037), il reserve-ratio post-withdraw legge un totalValue pre-swap (CORE-075) e Chainlink circuit breaker non incrementa mai (ADP-003) mentre TokenManager.getTokenPrice ritorna sempre isStale=false (CORE-044). Il risultato e una perdita persistente di solvibilita mascherata da un sistema che continua a funzionare normalmente.

history.note: Root finding created in S1.3 to aggregate valuation fail-open behaviours across the codebase. Confirmed by cross-referencing verification report (09) and code reads on ValueCalculator.getTotalPoolValue, ChainlinkAdapter, TokenManager, EulerV2Plugin.getHealthFactor, EulerLensAdapter, and LiquidityManager reserve ratio path.

title: encode-packed-collision: SwapManager.resetSwapStats hashes two dynamic strings with abi.encodePacked
impact: abi.encodePacked on two consecutive dynamic strings produces the same byte sequence for pair ("AB", "CD") and ("ABC", "D") - swapSuccesses / swapErrors / stats maps collide across such pairs. In the stats-only paths (getSwapStats, resetSwapStats, _handleSwapError) the effect is corrupted telemetry. In the execution paths (swapWithBestPlugin, _swapFromBaseAsset, _swapToBaseAsset, _swapTokenToToken) the pairHash is only used for stats accounting today, but the pattern is fragile and will bite if the hash is ever reused for a security-relevant lookup (e.g., per-pair slippage or per-pair pause).
prerequisites: Two token codes exist whose concatenation collides (e.g. 'US' + 'DC' vs 'USD' + 'C'). Currently mitigated because on-boarded codes are curated by owner, but no enforcement in TokenManager forbids codes that would collide.

history.note: NEW finding (not in audit register). Detector fires at keccak256(abi.encodePacked(spendTokenCode, receiveTokenCode)) (SwapManager.sol#1316). Sibling to PLG-061 (MorphoRegistry._marketKey), same class of bug but audit only tracked the Morpho occurrence. Registered as SLIT-005 to be batched with the other 6 SwapManager sites in Sprint 0 fix. Recommended fix: replace with keccak256(abi.encode(spendTokenCode, receiveTokenCode)) so ABI length-prefix distinguishes concatenation boundaries.

C1-09 fix applied (pipeline step 6). Introduced internal pure helper SwapManager._pairHash(string,string) using keccak256(abi.encode(a,b)) and replaced all 7 abi.encodePacked pairHash sites (lines 505/592/647/708 write, 1113 _handleSwapError, 1154 getSwapStats, 1316 resetSwapStats) with calls to it. abi.encode is size-prefixed and injective on the (string,string) tuple, so the concatenation-boundary collision is eliminated. Regression test test/foundry/unit/SwapManagerPairHash.t.sol (6 tests, PASS: known-collision cases, determinism, order-sensitivity, fuzz injectivity). Full Foundry suite: no regression (the 4 remaining failures are the pre-existing C1-03 share-inflation canaries, unrelated to SwapManager). Design doc: docs/New_Doc/1_Documentation/6. audit_2026_07/12-remediation-waves/Sprint0/C1-09_encode-packed-collision/. Fix currently in working tree (uncommitted); state moves to fixed-pending-verification pending @Poppo753 review + commit. title: closePositionsForBaseAsset ha semantica incoerente tra plugin (Aave=solo supply, Euler=solo leverage, Morpho=solo base-collateral, MorphoVault=tutto)
impact: closePositionsForBaseAsset chiude cose diverse in ogni plugin: AaveV3Plugin (L.454-476) ritira solo il base asset supplied (NON chiude leverage con debito); EulerV2Plugin (L.1403) chiude solo le posizioni leverage ordinate per rischio; MorphoPlugin (L.530) chiude solo mercati dove il base asset e' collaterale (repay+withdraw); MorphoVaultPlugin (L.196) redime tutti i vault supply. Per un design emergency 'No drain' (DEC-007) serve unwind UNIFORME e completo: con la semantica attuale, un'emergenza lascerebbe posizioni aperte non chiuse (es. su Aave una posizione leveraged WETH/USDC non verrebbe unwound se il base asset e' USDC).

history.note: Rilevato durante l'analisi C1-04/DEC-007 (No drain). Verificato leggendo closePositionsForBaseAsset in tutti e 5 i plugin. E' il prerequisito EMERGENCY-UNWIND per il design No-drain: serve semantica uniforme 'unwind TUTTO a base asset'. Si aggancia a C1-08 (interfaccia universale).

CORE-081 partially addressed by C1-08/C1-04: closePositionsForBaseAsset guard unified to onlyProtocolManager across lending plugins; MorphoVault now respects targetAmount; risk-ordering contract documented in IProtocolAdapter. FULL uniform sort-by-risk unwind that converts non-base collateral to base asset requires an internal swap with slippage protection = coupled with C1-06; kept fix-in-progress until C1-06 wires minAmountOut/maxSlippageBps.
